definitions.short: a contrivance , i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination)
definitions.full: H2810. chishshabon [ חִשָּׁבוֺן ] noun masculine device, invention (compare Lag BN 200 ) — only plural absolute חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת ; רַבִּים חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת בִקְשׁוּ וְהֵמָּה יָשָׁר אֶתהָֿאָדָם הָאֱלֹהִים עָשָׁה Eccl 7:29 God made mankind upright but they sought out many devices ; חֹוֺשֵׁב מַחֲשֶׁבֶת חִשְּׁבֹנוֺת וַיַּעַשׂ 2Chr 26:15 and he made contrivances (i.e. engines of war for hurling stones and arrows, see v b ) the invention of inventive men .
